title: 400 euro SEW premie op de WaterAccu in Vlaanderen
excerpt: The SEW premium (worth 400) is good news for users of the WaterAccu, the Nymo, in Belgium.
contentHtml:
What is the SEW premium?

As described by Fluvius, the SEW is for encouraging smart control: solutions that provide automatic control of devices that store or produce heat. These are devices such as home batteries, but also, for example, heat pumps and electric boilers. A control device therefore provides a better link between energy generation and energy consumption. The SEW premium encourages households to purchase control devices by reducing purchase and installation costs. The amount of the premium is 50% of the total invoice, with a maximum value of 400 euros. This premium is valid for installations with an invoice date between January 1, 2022 and December 31, 2024. The premium is therefore also valid for installations that have already been completed.

What does this mean for the WaterAccu?

The SEW premium is good news for users of the WaterAccu in Belgium. The smart box of the WaterAccu, the Nymo or the Solar iBoost, is on the list of approved devices for the SEW premium. This saves 297 to 400 euros on the purchase of the Nymo, depending on the installation costs. So submit both the purchase invoice and the installation invoice for maximum premium. This makes it even more interesting to use idle solar energy. The premium can be easily and quickly requested via the Fluvius website. Take advantage of it if you have already purchased a Nymo or Solar iBoost, or are considering purchasing!

No subsidy yet for WaterAccu in the Netherlands

Unfortunately, a comparable premium or subsidy is not yet available in the Netherlands. The WaterAccu is still a relatively new system in the Low Countries, and falls between the current subsidy categories. Of course we would like to realize this, so all tips and advice is welcome! But in Flanders there is already a wonderful opportunity to become even more sustainable with the WaterAccu. And this premium is still available for about a year and a half, so use the SEW premium as soon as possible!
